business_problem: However, increased digitalization of tax and compliance, adoption of technology by authorities, and convergence of data required from a regulatory perspective across domains, has led to the lines between tax, trade, and finance teams becoming blurred.
solution_summary: However, increased digitalization of tax and compliance, adoption of technology by authorities, and convergence of data required from a regulatory perspective across domains, has led to the lines between tax, trade, and finance teams becoming blurred. Thomson Reuters used Google Cloud and Looker to unify fragmented data sources, enabling customers to analyze compliance data across their organization, automate complex tax reconciliations and navigate changing global regulations with confidence. To address these converging challenges, Thomson Reuters sought a flexible platform that could sit atop their consolidated data lake in Google Cloud.
